config.description: Resolved finite MOF-5 powder pattern; deterministic complete cells.

physical_assumptions: independent identically distributed cells for bulk

crystallography.hydrogen_policy: retain unless explicitly excluded; missing hydrogens are not added
crystallography.solvent_policy: retain unless explicitly excluded by label/element; no solvent inference
crystallography.scattering_factors: neutral-atom IT92; reported ionic charges ignored
crystallography.coordinate_convention: fractional in [0,1); Cartesian angstrom = fractional @ cell_vectors_A

uncertainty: Numerical mean-amplitude variance is reported separately from physical disorder variance. No intensity SEM is claimed; refine angular grid and sample count.
sampled_moment_policy: Unbiased variance and mean-square correction; finite-sample negative estimates are retained.

numerical_approximation.description: Species-resolved radial Taylor moments and FFT; all finite-cell pair multiplicities retained.
numerical_approximation.bound: Absolute Taylor truncation plus displacement grouping bound; excludes floating-point roundoff.
numerical_approximation.validation: Accuracy must be checked against independent references and refinement; the bound is not a total floating-point error certificate.

actual_method.memory_scope: private histogram payload capped at 256 MiB; retained histograms, shape FFT, basis offsets, transform workspace and Python are additional
actual_method.approximation_bound: pointwise absolute Taylor plus displacement-merge bound; excludes floating-point accumulation and FFT roundoff
